newsitem.title: JAPAN: Peugeot to cut price of 306 model in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot to cut price of 306 model in Japan.

text.p: Inchcape Peugeot Japan Co Ltd, the importer and distributor for Peugeot in Japan, said on Monday it would cut the sales price of its mainstay model, the Peugeot 306, by an average of 5.2 percent on March 1.
The price cut is part of Peugeot's new sales strategy in Japan, a Peugeot Japan spokesman said.
Peugeot Japan hopes to boost sales to 7,000 units in calendar 1997 from 4,750 in 1996. Of the 1996 total, it sold 4,000 Peugeot 306s.
The price of the popular Peugeot 306 XSi three-door hatchback will be cut by 230,000 yen, or 8.4 percent, to 2.75 million yen.
